package.description: A free, cross-platform, versatile, powerful and feature-rich music player and collection manager.

en-US.description: A free, cross-platform, versatile, powerful and feature-rich music player and collection manager.
en-US.longDescription:
Amarok is a free, cross-platform, versatile, powerful and feature-rich music player and collection manager.
Features:
- Dynamic playlists matching different criteria
- Collection managing with rating support
- Support for basic iPod, MTP and UMS music player devices
- Integrated Internet services: last.fm, Magnatune, Ampache and more.
- Scripting support
- Cover manager
- Replay gain support
en-US.name: Amarok

zh-CN.description: 免费、跨平台、多功能、功能强大且丰富的音乐播放器和收藏管理器。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Amarok 是一款免费、跨平台、多功能、功能强大且丰富的音乐播放器和收藏管理器。
功能特点
- 符合不同标准的动态播放列表
- 支持评级的收藏管理
- 支持基本的 iPod、MTP 和 UMS 音乐播放器设备
- 集成互联网服务：last.fm、Magnatune、Ampache 等。
- 支持脚本
- 封面管理器
- 支持重放增益
